# redfish_manager_network_protocol (Resource)

Enables or disables BMC network services via the Redfish ManagerNetworkProtocol resource. Only configured attributes are managed. Destroy only removes the resource from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Unset protocols are not managed.
resource "redfish_manager_network_protocol" "bmc" {
  redfish_server { redfish_alias = "bmc" }
  ipmi_enabled = true
  ssh_enabled  = false
  ntp_enabled  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ipmi_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the IPMI service is enabled. Unset means unmanaged.
- `kvmip_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the KVMIP service is enabled. Unset means unmanaged.
- `manager_id` (String) Manager ID; defaults to the first manager.
- `ntp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the NTP service is enabled. Unset means unmanaged.
- `ntp_servers` (List of String) NTP servers.
- `redfish_server` (Block List) List of server BMCs and their respective user credentials (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--redfish_server))
- `snmp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SNMP service is enabled. Unset means unmanaged.
- `ssh_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SSH service is enabled. Unset means unmanaged.
- `virtual_media_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VirtualMedia service is enabled. Unset means unmanaged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Redfish URI of the NetworkProtocol resource.

<a id="nestedblock--redfish_server"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redfish_server`

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Server BMC IP address or hostname
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password for login
- `redfish_alias` (String) Alias name for server BMCs. The key in provider's `redfish_servers` map
- `ssl_insecure` (Boolean) This field indicates whether the SSL/TLS certificate must be verified or not
- `user` (String) User name for login
